author: Aussan Saad-Ali
excerpt: NetSPI Salesforce expert Aussan explores how holding identity steady across UI API, GraphQL, and custom @AuraEnabled Apex methods reveals hidden authorization gaps.
title: Authorization Differential Testing in Salesforce

author: Scott Weston
excerpt: Discover how a permission bypass in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) identity domains allowed lower-level administrator roles to create API keys for Identity Domain Administrators, leading to an unauthenticated privilege escalation path.
title: Administrating the Administrator, An OCI Identity Domains Permission Bypass

author: Rob Reeves
excerpt: Discover how a single DNS request can chain a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability into Remote Code Execution (RCE) on pfSense firewalls. Read the full technical breakdown of CVE-2026-78902 affecting the popular pfBlockerNG package.
title: CVE-2026-78902: XSS to RCE in pfSense with one DNS request

The attack surface of Azure has also increased with this growth. There are also a number of new and updated tools that give us…
title: Modern Adventures in Azure Privilege Escalation

author: Jake Scheetz
excerpt: NetSPI introduces EchoBench, a human-calibrated benchmark for autonomous AI web app pentesting. EchoBench measures finding fidelity, difficulty-reach, OWASP breadth, and repeatability to accurately gauge AI security capabilities against real human outcomes.
title: Introducing EchoBench: A Human Calibrated Benchmark for Autonomous Pentesting

author: Ceri Coburn
excerpt: Discover how BOFScale leverages a modified Tailscale daemon compiled as a BOF-PE to seamlessly hide C2 traffic and DERP relays behind CDNs using standard WebSockets.
title: BOFScale: A CDN-Fronted Tailnet from a BOF-PE

excerpt: ADPathFinder unifies SharpHound data with OpenGraph collectors like MSSQLHound and ConfigManBearPig. Discover how this tool maps complex, cross-dataset privilege escalation paths across AD, ADCS, MSSQL, and SCCM, and brings vital graph context to your password audits.
title: ADPathFinder: OpenGraph Attack Path Mapping in BloodHound CE
